rules.text: Ability: intelligence. Utilize: Detect poisoned drink (DC 15), or identify alcohol (DC 10). Craft: Antitoxin. Tool proficiency adds PB to ability checks using the tool; if also proficient in a skill used with the check, gain Advantage. Each Artisan tool needs its own proficiency.

authored_operations: Utilize chooses one task: Detect poisoned drink (DC 15), or identify alcohol (DC 10). Use intelligence, the declared DC and actual tool copy; apply PB for the matching proficiency and Advantage when the applicable skill is also proficient.
